steps.code:
# Parse the file list and reorganize
import re

access_token = login_response['access_token']
base_dir = '~/documents/work/meetings/'

# Filter only files (not directories)
file_paths = [f for f in files if not f.endswith('/')]

for file_path in file_paths:
    # Extract basename
    basename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split by __ to get date and rest
    if '__' not in basename:
        continue
    date_part, rest = basename.split('__', 1)
    # Split rest on last dot to get file_name and extension
    if '.' not in rest:
        continue
    file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    # Create directory named file_name
    new_dir = base_dir + file_name + '/'
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=new_dir, recursive=True)
    # New file path
    new_file_path = new_dir + date_part + '.' + ext
    # Move file
    apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=new_file_path)
    print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {new_file_path}")
